BRIEF.md
2026-09-14 — eleven caller cases, source preparation only

This proposal adapts the accepted fake30 loader and parent receipts to the frozen reliability caller and its eleven controls. It loads seven modules in dependency order and nine child text inputs. The parent binds thirteen files plus its admission and PINS controls. The original fake30 cases and sources remain untouched.

Five context modules are exact accepted copies. The caller (0165e56a...) and tests (55f98704...) are exact author-frozen bytes. EXPECTED-CASES.json is the author's exact eleven-ID file. SOURCE-INPUTS.json records complete source paths and hashes; no fixture, model, media or installed support file is included.

The loader preserves its preload list, audit/import/content restrictions, twelve metadata traps, built-in winreg baseline and callable traps, capture limits, explicit-module test selection and result/subtest accounting. Only the fixed closure, case count, receipt labels and final identity targets change. The identity check now binds the loaded reservation/resolver/adapter entries and caller functions, restored Path and absent media-ticket dependency. The resolver approval and five adapter services must still be None.

The tests exercise the actual caller, OperationFacade and SegmentStream using inert base-lifecycle/session services. One refusal case enters the actual closed adapter. These cases do not establish durable adapter admission, decoding, real cleanup, model execution or production migration.

The earlier plan's Word.text concern was a reviewer reading error. The original read already contained both word and text access; the source was not repaired for this concern. The original plan and its correction remain in reliability-request-stream-qualification-plan01.

No candidate has run. ROOT-ADMISSION.template.json is false; only root may admit a later invocation after source and instrument review.

QUALIFICATION-PROTOCOL.md
Run exactly the eleven IDs in EXPECTED-CASES.json, in their supplied order, only after root creates a separate ROOT-ADMISSION.json bound to this preparation's final PINS. No actual admission or run directory is prepared here.

`$env:IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE='C:\Users\hello\AppData\Local\Uoink\index.db'; & 'C:\Users\hello\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe' -NoProfile -File 'E:\AI\projects\uoink\checkouts\Yoink-library\_scratch\reliability-request-stream-fake11-author01\run_fake11_01.ps1'; exit $global:LASTEXITCODE`

The launcher invokes only C:\Python314\python.exe with -I -S -B. It requires the fresh label reliability-request-stream-fake01, verifies thirteen pinned parent inputs and three controls before copying, scrubs credential environment names, and sets the lexical live-index refusal value before child startup. The child reads only seven modules, itself and the expected list, then closes content reads before compiling pinned source bytes. Heavy imports, filesystem operations, metadata and registry calls remain refused.

Module order is snapshot_lifecycle, snapshot_reservations, durable_lifecycle, trusted_asr_resolver, asr_loading_adapter, uoink_reliability, then test_reliability_request_stream. The durable factory's type is needed by the actual adapter import. Its deferred generated-adapter recovery imports remain outside this closure and these tests. No new standard-library preload is added.

Use the existing limits: 1 MiB per child source, 8,192 characters per incidental capture, 64 subtests per case and 262,144 bytes for the result. These are instrument bounds, not a hard process-time guarantee. The proposed tests make no actual file or kernel calls; their Path replacement affects only the reliability module.

Immediately after child return, capture global LASTEXITCODE and durably write native-exit.json before any postcheck. Retain stdout.json, stderr.log, plan.json, input-check.json, exit.json or launch-failure.json and the exact outer tool object. If execution yields a session, save both initial and terminal actual objects. Never infer an outer exit from the child's receipt. Any failure stops this unit; no retry is admitted.

Acceptance requires the exact eleven ordered case objects, 11/0/0, all ten guards, no denials or heavy roots, zero incidental capture/stderr, native and outer zero, and unchanged original/copied inputs and controls. Compare author and independently admitted case objects directly; elapsed values may differ. Nine child hashes must match the pinned source map. False template alone grants no execution.

A later independent copy may use a fresh proposal directory and the distinct reliability-request-stream-confirmation01 label, changing only the five launcher label literals and corresponding control pins. It must retain all nine child bytes. No independent copy or invocation is created by this preparation.
